Emma (Head of Product): quick all-hands Q&A follow-up  want to capture the short list of why-we-won vs why-we-lost and immediate asks. keeping it tight.
Raj (Sales): wins = predictable latency in pilots, clear onboarding playbooks. losses = inability to promise VPC/HSM, surprise token-cost spikes, and model regressions after updates.
Sophia (CS): example: ParkAssist left after a hallucination in billing; they needed a reproducible eval and a rollback guarantee.
Ben (Customer Success): recurring customer asks: 1) "1-week VPC quickstart" 2) "latency premium tier" 3) "billing cap + notify" 4) "tiny regression kit customers can run".
Lin (Eng PM): short fixes: billing-cap toggle + webhook (1 sprint), fallback routing to smaller hosted model (1 sprint), VPC quickstart docs + terraform module (3 sprints). bigger: HSM add-on (3+ months).
Maria (Applied ML): model-quality note: 2 regressions traced to a quant/profile change. mitigation = pre-release sampled-run on customer golden prompts + pin quant profiles. small CI hook, high impact.
David (CEO): leadership asks: can product/eng/legal deliver 1-pagers for VPC quickstart, latency tier offer, and loss-playbook by next Tue? we'll review and decide resourcing.
Emma (Head of Product): will coordinate. proposed owners: Lin = VPC quickstart one-pager, Tom/Finance = latency tier cost model, Ben+Raj = loss-playbook, Maria = regression FAQ + CI hook.
Raj (Sales): Q: can the fallback include a customer-facing webhook + email template so they aren't surprised?
Lin (Eng PM): yes  we'll implement notify+downgrade: route -> hosted_small + send_webhook/email. basic PRD in the one-pager. est: 1 sprint.
Sophia (CS): please include example cost deltas for batching vs latency in the FAQ so sales can set expectations.
Maria (Applied ML): will add a one-page table: config -> approx token-cost delta -> accuracy note.
Ben (Customer Success): i'll gather exact prospect language for the one-pagers to help legal craft SLA wording.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: action created: "VPC quickstart one-pager" owner: Lin, due: 7 days; "loss-playbook" owner: Ben, due: 14 days.
David (CEO): thanks  keep docs concise and call out unknowns. leadership review next Wed.
Emma (Head of Product): posting notes + follow-ups here after review: https://redwoodhq.internal/allhands/1949007777-notes. please keep subsequent replies short so i can turn them into tickets.
Raj (Sales): noted, thanks.
Ben (Customer Success): tagging owners: @Lin @Maria @Tom.
Emma (Head of Product): end.
